_comment: The hand-kept book: any symbol Yahoo Finance knows, in any market (AAPL, RELIANCE.NS, MC.PA, 0700.HK). Edit here or in the Desk · Book page, which writes this file. Prices come from Yahoo's free feed: US listings close to live, most other exchanges 15 to 20 minutes behind. Lines with zero shares are ignored. Each currency is totalled on its own; the desk never converts between them.
